name: Lograsi
source: Pathfinder Adventure Path #221: Into the Apocalypse Archive

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

defensiveAbilities.name: Evasive Response
defensiveAbilities.description: When Lograsi rolls a success on a Reflex save, he gets a critical success instead. He isn't Off-Guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures of level 18 or lower.

defensiveAbilities.name: Unexpected Parry
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within Lograsi's reach attempts to Strike Lograsi with a melee weapon

Effect Lograsi attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. The triggering creature is Off-Guard to this attack. If the attack is a critical hit, Lograsi disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward his multiple attack penalty, and his multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Numbing Strike
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Lograsi's Strike hits an Off-Guard creature and deals damage

Effect The target becomes Clumsy 1 and takes a –10 foot status penalty to their Speeds from overwhelming chills that numb their flesh. This lasts until the end of Lograsi's next turn.

Effect: Numbing Strike

offensiveAbilities.name: Shadowy Wings
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Lograsi rolls initiative or Leaps

Effect As one of the favored pawns of the velstrac demagogue Aroggus, Lograsi has been granted a pair of shadowy wings. When he activates his Shadowy Wings, they spring from his back and grant him a 40-foot fly Speed. He can sustain his Shadowy Wings for one round at the start of his turn as a free action. As long as his Shadowy Wings are active, Lograsi gains a +2 status bonus on all Acrobatics and Stealth checks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Lograsi does an additional 3d6 precision damage to creatures that are Off-Guard.
